top_signals.title: Oil Advances on Threats to Supply From Russia to Middle East
top_signals.summary: Oil rose as Ukraine cast doubt on an “energy ceasefire” touted by US President Donald Trump. Saudi Arabia suffered its deadliest strikes since the Iran war began, with new drone and cruise missile assaults posing fresh security threats to the kingdom. Michelle Brouhard, Head of Policy and Geopolitical Risk at Kpler, joins Bloomberg Intelligence to discuss. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
